features.name: Pact Magic
features.desc: You cast spells from the Warlock spell list using Charisma. Your Pact Magic slots are few, all of the same (highest available) level, and you regain them when you finish a Short Rest.

features.name: Eldritch Invocations
features.desc: You learn Eldritch Invocations, permanent magical enhancements. The number you know increases with level; some require a certain level, a Pact Boon, or a cantrip.

features.name: Pact Boon
features.desc: You choose a Pact Boon as an invocation: Pact of the Blade (weapon + attacks using Charisma), Pact of the Chain (familiar), Pact of the Tome (cantrips and rituals), or Pact of the Talisman.

features.name: Magical Cunning
features.desc: By performing a 1-minute rite, you regain some of your expended Pact Magic spell slots. Once per Long Rest.

features.name: Contact Patron
features.desc: You can cast Contact Other Plane without a spell slot (reaching out to your patron) and without risking insanity.

features.name: Mystic Arcanum (Level 6)
features.desc: You choose one level 6 spell as your arcanum; you can cast it once per Long Rest without a spell slot.

features.name: Mystic Arcanum (Level 7)
features.desc: An additional level 7 spell as an arcanum (once per Long Rest).

features.name: Mystic Arcanum (Level 8)
features.desc: An additional level 8 spell as an arcanum (once per Long Rest).

features.name: Mystic Arcanum (Level 9)
features.desc: An additional level 9 spell as an arcanum (once per Long Rest).

features.name: Eldritch Master
features.desc: Once per Long Rest, with a 1-minute rite, you regain all expended Pact Magic spell slots.
